summary: Defines semantics for grouping source flows and Forward Error Correction repair flows in SDP, to be used with the SDP Grouping Framework (RFC 5888). It supports additive repair flows and SSRC-level grouping for RTP streams. It is a Proposed Standard and replaced RFC 4756.

eli5.summary: Pairing a video stream with its spare repair pieces so a receiver knows which patches fix which picture.

questions: how to describe fec repair flows in sdp
